Source branch: agentic-data-collection-mop  (the MoP worktree)
Source commit: 3747634854d05be8d17324c488f72342be14f3d1
Source path  : OmniGibson/omnigibson/action_primitives/low_primives_for_agent.py

This file is maintained by the MoP team. The failure-recovery pipeline depends on
it ONLY through executor/low_prim_adapter.py (a thin wrapper, one method per public
method). To pick up upstream changes, re-copy this single file from the MoP worktree
at the same path and re-run the adapter smoke-test — do not hand-edit it here.

Notes:
- Its one FR-foreign dependency, `from omnigibson.learning.embodiedClaw.mop_controller
  import resolve_target_object`, is inside `_resolve_object` under try/except and falls
  back to `env.task.object_scope`, so it runs in this worktree without porting
  mop_controller. The adapter resolves object words via embodiedClaw_recovery's own
  ObjectResolver and never relies on the engine's resolver.
- It expects ROBOT_CFG=r1pro_mop semantics (position-mode JointController everywhere;
  robot.q_to_action asserts non-delta JointController). r1pro_mop.yaml was vendored
  alongside it at OmniGibson/omnigibson/learning/configs/robot/r1pro_mop.yaml.
- curobo.py / starter_semantic_action_primitives.py were NOT vendored: this worktree's
  versions are API-compatible and carry the FR-only AG-serialize fix.
